newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Galicia announces price for B shares.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Galicia announces price for B shares.

text.p: Argentina's Banco de Galicia announced Tuesday that the reference price to be in effect on Wednesday is pesos 4.9047 per ordinary B share and US$19.6188 per ADS.
The bank commenced an offering of rights to its existing shareholders to subscribe for an aggregate 35 million of the bank's ordinary B shares on October 17.

The rights will entitle each shareholder to subscribe for 7.3 million ordinary B shares or ADS as the case may be, for each ordinary B share or ADS, as the case may be, held of record on October 16, at the subscription price to be established on or about October 29.
The rights offering will expire on October 25 for holders of the bank's ADSs and October 28 for holders of the ordinary B shares.
